title: Kara Leier

CV

About
After finishing my undergraduate degrees in computer science and linguistics, I completed a Masters of Data Science with a specialization in Computational Linguistics. Since then I have started working as a Research Analyst for the Vaccine and Infectious Disease Organization (VIDO) on the University of Saskatchewan campus.
